name: Enjou Gakuen 2: Shitenshi-tachi no Hanazono
original_name: 艶嬢学園２ ～熾天使たちの花園～
source:
In a prestigious academy nestled deep within the mountains, far from civilization, a dark secret lurks. Hidden beyond its heavy iron gates are cruel and heartless "witches"—innocent yet wicked young ladies who take pleasure in igniting scandals, delighting in the fiery spectacle of others' suffering. Their seemingly petty mischief plunges the peaceful daily lives of innocent people into a blazing inferno.

To deliver the iron hammer of "education" upon these ruthless young women, one man rises to the challenge once again. His name is Yamato Masayoshi, a specialist in quelling scandalous fires, a man driven by a passionate resolve. Awaiting him in the depths of this ancient academy are noble ladies—whether they are pure or depraved, only time will tell.

[Translated from [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/enjogakuen2/overview.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
在一所坐落在远离文明的深山里的著名学院里，潜伏着一个黑暗的秘密。厚重的铁门后面隐藏着残酷无情的“女巫”——天真却邪恶的年轻女士，她们以煽动丑闻为乐，以他人痛苦的火热场面为乐。他们看似微不足道的恶作剧让无辜人民平静的日常生活陷入了熊熊大火。

为了向这些无情的年轻女性发出“教育”的铁锤，一名男子再次迎难而上。他的名字叫大和正义，一位平息丑闻火灾的专家，一个充满激情的决心的人。在这座古老书院的深处等待着他的，是高贵的女子，她们是纯洁的，还是堕落的，只有时间才能证明一切。

[翻译自[url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/enjogakuen2/overview.html]官方网站[/url]]
